sources.title: StarVLA: A Lego-like Codebase for Vision-Language-Action Model Developing
sources.snippet: StarVLA: a unified platform for exploring embodied intelligence. We introduce StarVLA, an open-source research platform that brings VLM-based and world-model-based VLA paradigms into a unified modular framework.
